summary:
The Columbarium and Memorial Garden is hallowed ground, sacred to the memory of those that have departed from our midst.  It is a tranquil and welcoming place for visitation and meditation.

The Columbarium houses 48 Niches for cremains.  The Wall of Remberane has 48 Memorial Plaques.

For more detailed information, please contact the Church Office
title: Columbarium and Memorial Garden
